name: EGB OE TL.Z./FRESENIUS
summary: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA is a global healthcare group that provides products and services for dialysis, hospitals and outpatient medical care. The company operates through four segments: Fresenius Medical Care, Fresenius Kabi, Fresenius Helios, and Fresenius Vamed. The company is headquartered in Bad Homburg, Germany.
